description: This file defines the UpdateMeetingAttendanceCommandHandler class, responsible for handling commands related to updating or saving meeting attendance within the Fineract project. It uses Spring annotations for service declaration and transaction management, and delegates the core logic to MeetingWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateMeetingAttendanceCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles the updating or saving of meeting attendance via commands.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to update or save attendance by delegating to the MeetingWritePlatformService.
